method_card.objective: Develop a missing read-only CPU method for evidence coverage by accession, for use later in the same Goal.
method_card.mechanism: Supply one UTF-8 method source plus a unique exact source_quote (12–240 chars). Set cohort_rows/evidence_rows to the JSON array field (or $ for a root array); set cohort_id/evidence_id to exact common-namespace key fields, evidence_value to an observed text or finite numeric field. Names are literal, including case. The builder calibrates before exposing a package for gx_install_record_method.
method_card.estimator: Coverage is the number of distinct cohort IDs with a nonempty matching value divided by all distinct cohort IDs. Numeric zero is a present value. A missing/invalid cohort ID makes the denominator ambiguous and the method fails.
method_card.training_data_lineage: An independent declarative extension of identifier mapping, with the chosen article/snapshot quoted by line and byte digest.

manifest.licence_basis: GX record analysis template published with this release.
manifest.limitations: Analytical method authoring is limited to a documented distinct-key evidence join. ID proximity, homology, sampling independence and semantic annotation correctness are outside scope.
